source_sql:
--==============================================================================
-- D. 集計
--==============================================================================
-- D-1. GROUP BY / HAVING
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(salary) AS total, ROUND(AVG(salary)) AS avg_sal
FROM   employees
GROUP  BY department_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER  BY total DESC
